description:
## [1.10.3](https://github.com/sjshb57/Pairip-Patches/compare/v1.10.2...v1.10.3) (2026-08-29)

### 🔧 Improvements

chore: upgrade Gradle, dependencies, and refine patch configuration
- Upgrade Gradle wrapper to 9.7.1.
- Bump `morphe-patcher` to 1.11.0 and `app.morphe.patches` plugin to 1.3.4.
- Remove experimental `-Xcontext-parameters` Kotlin compiler flag.
- Refactor `patchListGeneratorClasspath` configuration in `patches/build.gradle.kts`.
- Update npm devDependencies including `semantic-release` to v25.0.9 and `@semantic-release/git` to v11.0.1.
- Update GitHub Action versions for `setup-java` (v5.7.0) and `setup-node` (v7) in the release workflow.
